Hi Clara,

I know things have been incredibly hectic with your startup lately, and it seems like you've been neglecting yourself and your tech infrastructure. I found a group that can handle those {{1}} to ensure your business doesn't crash during the next push. They even offer a complimentary diagnostic for newcomers just to ensure everything is running smooth. Since your wedding is approaching, you really should grab one of their {{2}} before they are all gone for the day. It would be a great way to handle your prep and maybe even get that extra treatment for your hair without paying a cent. Also, since you've been so tense, I think having someone come over for a {{3}} would be much better than you trying to find time to travel to a clinic. If we book a few sessions together, the {{4}} effectively makes the third visit a gift. It seems like the best way to maintain your {{5}} without adding more travel to your plate.

Love,
Oliver
